summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing the results of its annual general meeting held on the same day. All proposed resolutions submitted for shareholder approval were adopted, including routine governance matters. The filing discloses share counts as of the record date: 613,369,540 total issued shares (543,206,907 Class A and 70,162,633 Class B). No special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital returns is present. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of annual meeting results, not triggering a special-situations classification.
